name: reactions_add
description: Adds a reaction (emoji) to a message; validates the (channel, timestamp) message exists and rejects already_reacted duplicates (POST /reactions.add)

channel.description: Channel where the message to add reaction to was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to add reaction to.

name.description: Reaction (emoji) name, without colons, e.g. thumbsup.
